Listing.title: Land Listing
Listing.description: A verified land or property listing in Tanzania with photos, video, location, and technical parameters

type.description: Classification of land (Residential, Agricultural, Commercial, Industrial, Mixed Use, etc.)

status.description: Availability status of the land: available (inauzwa), sold (imeshauzwa), or reserved (imewekewa nafasi)

approvalStatus.description: Administrative moderation approval status: approved (published to buyers), pending (awaiting admin review & payment check), or rejected

paymentConfirmed.description: Whether listing/listing fee payment between seller and admin has been settled

approvedAt.description: Timestamp when admin approved listing for public viewing

adminNotes.description: Administrative notes regarding payment or verification

unit.description: Unit of measurement (Ekari, Mita za Mraba, Hekta, etc.)

region.description: Tanzanian Region where the land is located

images.description: List of compressed photos or URLs representing the land

videoUrl.description: Optional video URL (Uploaded video blob or cloud URL)

videoTitle.description: Title or label for the video tour

videoFileName.description: Original file name of the uploaded video

videoSize.description: Size of the uploaded video file in bytes

beaconsPlaced.description: Whether survey beacons/vigingi have been fixed on boundaries

leasePeriod.description: Lease duration or tenure status (e.g., Miaka 99, Miaka 66, Kimila)

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the listing was created

/listings/{listingId}.description: Collection of Tanzanian land listings available on the LandVault marketplace
